aiDescriptions.n: SageMaker Catalog (separate product) drafts table and column descriptions with Bedrock. Docs name Glue tables; Redshift table support not confirmed.

bulkMetadata.n: Redshift COMMENT ON is native SQL (doc page unreachable, Unverified). Catalog API CreateAssetRevision updates one asset per call.

autoClassify.n: No classification feature for Redshift columns found in the sources I could reach. Unverified.

sampleValues.n: Only in Amazon Quick Topics: authors set CellValueSynonyms by hand. No automatic value sampling found for Redshift.

queryHistory.n: No query-history mining for joins, metrics or examples found. Query Editor v2 doc was unreachable. Unverified.

lineage.n: SageMaker Catalog captures column-level lineage from Redshift, Glue and Spark (GA Dec 2024). Redshift is named as a source.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL eval tooling or feedback-to-example loop found for Q generative SQL or Quick Topics. Unverified.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Write table and column comments in Redshift with COMMENT ON, then publish the tables to SageMaker Catalog. There, run the DataZone StartMetadataGenerationRun API with types BUSINESS_DESCRIPTIONS and BUSINESS_NAMES, and review the drafts. The API takes at most 2 types per call, and the asset type must be supported.

bulkSnippet.code:
# One asset per call. types accepts at most 2 values.
aws datazone start-metadata-generation-run \
  --domain-identifier $DOMAIN_ID \
  --owning-project-identifier $PROJECT_ID \
  --target type=ASSET,identifier=$ASSET_ID \
  --types BUSINESS_DESCRIPTIONS BUSINESS_NAMES

sampleValues.n: No sample-value or literal-matching feature found. Natural language search filters object metadata only, not data values.

queryHistory.n: No query-history mining for joins, measures or examples found in the docs reviewed.

lineage.n: Impact and Lineage Analysis supports column-level analysis, but only for tables, graphical and SQL views, and analytic models.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL eval tooling or feedback loop found. AI SQL view generation takes free-text prompts only.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Turn on SAP Business AI for the tenant, then use AI-assisted catalog content generation to draft summaries and descriptions for catalog assets. In the Data Builder, run Generate > Generate Semantics to set semantic usage, keys and column semantic types. For scripted edits, export objects to CSN/JSON, edit them, and import them back, or use the datasphere command line.

evals.n: Data agent evaluation SDK (Preview): ground truth CSV, evaluate_data_agent, critic prompt. evaluate_few_shots checks SQL examples.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Add descriptions and synonyms to tables, columns and measures in the semantic model. Draft measure descriptions with Copilot or with generate_measure_descriptions in semantic-link-labs, then review them. Keep AI instructions in Prep data for AI (Preview) and add few-shot examples to the data agent with add_fewshots.

autoClassify.n: Data Discovery and Classification recommends labels from column names only (SQL Server 2012+). You accept them in SSMS or with ADD SENSITIVITY CLASSIFICATION.

queryHistory.n: No mining of query history for semantic suggestions found. Query Store is not documented as an AI input.

lineage.n: No native column lineage found. Mirroring into Fabric gives item-level lineage only. Purview scanning not checked.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL eval tooling found for SQL Server or Azure SQL. Fabric data agent eval needs Fabric items.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Store business meaning as extended properties with sys.sp_addextendedproperty and the name MS_Description, and loop over a metadata table to write many. Update existing ones with sys.sp_updateextendedproperty. Run Data Discovery and Classification in SSMS to tag sensitive columns.

notes.text: The shared WebSearch budget ran out early. docs.aws.amazon.com, aws.amazon.com and learn.microsoft.com could not be fetched. Most facts come from raw GitHub doc sources (MicrosoftDocs, SAP-docs, botocore) that I fetched, so 'not found' means not found in what I reached.

I could not confirm Redshift COMMENT ON syntax, Query Editor v2 generative SQL use of query history or sample values, Quick Topics sampling, or any classification feature. Levels for those caps are 0 or based on a related API only.

Search results say the feature drafts business descriptions and column descriptions with Bedrock for custom structured assets, and in May 2026 it reached IAM-based domains. The DataZone API StartMetadataGenerationRun takes types BUSINESS_DESCRIPTIONS, BUSINESS_NAMES and BUSINESS_GLOSSARY_ASSOCIATIONS, max 2 per call, and the older single type field is deprecated since 2025-11-21. Docs require a supported asset type such as a Glue table; I did not confirm Redshift tables.
The Dec 2024 GA announcement says lineage covers columns from Glue, Redshift and Spark. The July 2026 update for IAM-based domains names Spark jobs on EMR and Glue and does not mention Redshift.
